title: CharacterCore
description: Creator-owned, global, mutable draft. RCE-003. Holds the working draft and pointers to published releases; a core edit never mutates a release or an existing scenario (INV-009). Unlike a release, a draft core may carry an unknown age — it simply cannot be published until the age is known and adult (INV-032).

draft_age.description: May be known, unknown or contested while drafting. Publishing requires known and adult.

current_release_id.description: Absent until the first release is published. Absence means never published, not 'unknown'.

release_ids.description: Every published release, oldest first. Append-only.
